text:
maria_ops: Hey team — seeing apiserver p95 jump to ~1.8s and controller-manager leader flips in northamerica1 since ~09:07 UTC. Also noticing a backlog of GPU attach failures and `AttachVolume timeout`. Any ideas? :eyes:
jonathan_sre: Yep, alerts firing for apiserver.latency.p95 and controller-manager.leader_changes (x7 in 10m). I also see a bunch of egress errors from control-plane hosts to external services, looks like rate limiting / SNAT exhaustion.
olga_network: Confirming from network side — NAT gateway reported `EgressRateLimitExceeded` around 09:05. Provider logs: `error=EgressRateLimitExceeded resource=nat-gw-3 region=northamerica1`. A lot of KMS/artifact pulls spiking at same time.
lee_infra: That explains the GPU attach backlog — controller-manager can't reach cloud attach API so nodes get stuck in AttachWait. Example error from controller logs: `AttachVolume rpc timeout: code = DeadlineExceeded`.
maria_ops: Etcd follower write-queue latency rose too, but snapshots/compaction I/O looks fine. Feels like control-plane reconnect storms leading to leader churn.
jonathan_sre: Short-term mitigation: disable noncritical control-plane egress (external metrics, telemetry, dev artifact syncs) and switch registry pulls to a local mirror. Anyone can toggle?
olga_network: I can flip the mirror and pause the metrics-forwarder. Doing mirror switch now for container registry and pausing external telemetry.
deploy-bot: Automated action: paused job `metrics-forwarder-prod` (id: jf-87). Reason: egress-throttle-mitigation.
lee_infra: Opening a cloud support ticket for transient egress quota bump and NAT scaling. Ticket CN-84291 created. Adding logs and timeline.
sam_cost: FYI scaling NAT/allowing burst will cost ~ $1.2k/day if we keep it for full region for 24h. Recommend we only allow critical control-plane egress.
maria_ops: Agreed. Which services are nonessential? Suggestions: external audit sink, dev artifact syncs, CI image prefetches, telemetry-forwarder.
jonathan_sre: Plan proposed: 1) cut noncritical egress, 2) ensure mirror used for registry pulls, 3) gently restart controller-manager candidates to stabilize leader, 4) monitor etcd follower latencies. We'll do rolling restarts to avoid mass leader churn.
olga_network: Mirror switch completed, metrics-forwarder paused, routing updated to private mirror (registry-northamerica1.internal).
lee_infra: Provider responded: "temporary egress burst enabled for 30m". Monitoring metrics now. They asked us to move heavy artifact pulls to mirror and not rely on burst.
maria_ops: After burst enabled, apiserver p95 came down to ~220ms and leader flips stopped. GPU attach backlog is draining. :thumbsup:
sam_cost: Good recovery, but we should choose long-term: increase NAT pool size, add per-region egress proxies, or require mirrors + limits on control-plane external pulls. I'll model cost impact for each.
jonathan_sre: Postmortem action items: add nat-pool auto-scale, route heavy control-plane pulls to mirrors by default, add synthetic alert correlating leader changes with egress-rate-limit errors, and add runbook for controller-manager leader stabilization.
maria_ops: Owners: lee_infra -> cloud ticket + nat autoscale; olga_network -> mirror gating + routing; jonathan_sre -> alerting + runbook; sam_cost -> cost thresholds and approval gating. I'll keep this channel open for an hour.
lee_infra: Ack. Updating ticket CN-84291 with runbook and cost constraints now.
jonathan_sre: Still watching, looks stable at the moment. :eyes:
maria_ops: Will close thread in 45m unless new alerts. Thanks everyone.
